cards.mechanism: Stacked fully connected blocks use backward and forward residual links for forecasting.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Original results concern univariate forecasts and do not transfer automatically.

cards.mechanism: Reversible instance normalization removes and restores instance statistics for forecasting under distribution shift.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Input normalization cannot use unseen future sequence statistics or future targets.

cards.mechanism: The Transformer uses attention in place of recurrence and convolution for sequence modeling.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Its machine-translation training advantages are not evidence of Connectome benefit.

cards.mechanism: The paper studies post-hoc calibration of classification confidence and finds temperature scaling effective on its datasets.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Classification probability calibration is not the same objective as weighted Pearson regression.

cards.mechanism: Progressive decomposition and auto-correlation model recurring sub-series patterns.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Original long-horizon forecasting setup is not directly deployable here.

cards.mechanism: An autoregressive network conditions each output on preceding audio samples.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Audio-generation evidence does not establish Connectome WP improvement.

cards.mechanism: Multi-resolution recurrent skip connections shorten paths across long sequences.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: The reported long-dependency tasks differ from this competition.

cards.mechanism: A learned sum of per-feature neural functions captures nonlinear univariate effects.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Featurewise additivity omits interactions unless explicitly extended.

cards.mechanism: Output weights are trained as readout functions of fixed recurrent activations using linear regression.
cards.assumptions: The paper analyzes echo-state networks and their state properties.
cards.limitations: A pretrained GRU is not the paper reservoir. No echo-state theorem or improvement guarantee transfers; exact causal-prefix and state-parity checks are required.

cards.mechanism: Stagewise additive function estimation is connected to steepest descent in function space and generalized beyond least-squares fitting.
cards.assumptions: Curator adaptation: estimate all objective moments from training rows, and test the fitted direction on fixed search evidence.
cards.limitations: The paper does not validate this task, clipped weighted Pearson, or the proposed single ridge gradient step. The pooled objective is nonseparable and its derivative must be independently checked.

cards.mechanism: A finite-context gated convolution can model sequences while allowing parallel training.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Its language-model latency comparison is not a deployment guarantee here.

cards.mechanism: GRU and LSTM gates regulate recurrent state; the paper compares gated units with simpler recurrence.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Comparable GRU and LSTM results in the paper do not imply a gain on this task.

cards.mechanism: The paper evaluates a simple convolutional sequence architecture against recurrent baselines and reports longer effective memory on its benchmarks.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Past local TCN experiments here are search evidence and should not be overwritten by external benchmarks.

cards.mechanism: Hierarchical echo-state reservoirs and projections are used to represent multiscale time series.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Echo-state stability and useful timescales require explicit checking.

cards.mechanism: Importance weighting adjusts cross-validation risk when input distributions differ.
cards.assumptions: Covariate shift keeps the conditional target distribution given inputs unchanged.
cards.limitations: Input drift alone does not establish this assumption. The paper does not provide a clipped Pearson guarantee.

cards.mechanism: The paper tests simple one-layer linear forecasting baselines against complex transformers.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Published comparisons target long-term forecasting benchmarks, not this scoring rule.

cards.mechanism: Gated first-order dynamical systems have state-dependent time constants.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: The paper's time-series results do not establish feasibility under this callback budget.

cards.mechanism: Memory cells and gates address difficult long-range gradient propagation in recurrent learning.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Long-memory motivation does not establish that larger recurrence is necessary here.

cards.mechanism: Adaptive linearization enables stochastic updates for specific nondecomposable classification metrics.
cards.assumptions: The analyzed metrics are concave or pseudo-linear functions of true positive and negative rates.
cards.limitations: Its classification convergence guarantees do not apply to clipped weighted Pearson. The task derivative needs separate verification.

cards.mechanism: A regularized linear readout uses delayed observations and polynomial features of their joint history.
cards.assumptions: Paper benchmarks are low-dimensional dynamical systems; transfer to this task is unestablished.
cards.limitations: Full polynomial bases grow combinatorially. A featurewise EMA interaction is a restricted adaptation, not a reproduction or universality guarantee.

cards.mechanism: HiPPO incrementally compresses signal history using polynomial projections.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Compression quality depends on assumptions about past-time weighting.

cards.mechanism: PatchTST segments time series into patches and shares a channel-independent transformer.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Long-term forecast benchmarks differ from online one-row prediction.

cards.mechanism: Residual blocks learn adjustments relative to their inputs, easing optimization of deeper networks.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: The paper studies image classification, not causal regression correction.

cards.mechanism: Biased shrinkage stabilizes regression coefficients when predictors are nonorthogonal.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Global linear effects cannot express all conditional or long-memory errors.

cards.mechanism: V-REx penalizes variance of training-domain risks to reduce sensitivity to distribution shifts.
cards.assumptions: Training-domain variation must represent relevant future variation.
cards.limitations: Prediction-mean quartiles may not be actual domains. Penalizing WP improvement variance is a curator adaptation, not a reproduction or a task guarantee.

cards.mechanism: Input-dependent state-space parameters selectively propagate or forget information.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Its results are on other modalities and should not dominate simpler mechanisms.

cards.mechanism: A trainable gate selects a sparse subset of feed-forward experts per example.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: The published very-large-scale setting is far from this deployment budget.

cards.mechanism: Informer introduces sparse attention and distilling for long-sequence forecasting.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Original architecture predicts future sequences in one operation, unlike this callback.

cards.mechanism: S4 parameterizes state-space dynamics to model long sequences efficiently.
cards.assumptions: Transfer to Connectome requires an independent search-only test.
cards.limitations: Published long-sequence benchmark gains do not predict local WP.
